name: Urgent Message
summary: Brave Moonhorn warns Freewind Post that centaur raids are growing across Thousand Needles. Travelers and the roads are in danger.

sections.title: A Warning from the Heights
sections.body:
Near the Great Lift from the Barrens into Thousand Needles, Brave Moonhorn writes Urgent Message. From there, Moonhorn watches the jagged canyons below as centaur tribes renew their raids on Horde travelers.

The letter is bound for Cliffwatcher Longhorn atop Freewind Post. Moonhorn warns that attackers have grown bolder and strike near important roads. The garrison must prepare for more fighting and watch for the unpredictable Grimtotem clan.

sections.title: Bloodshed on the Canyon Floor
sections.body:
At Freewind Post, Urgent Message confirms Cliffwatcher Longhorn's fears. Centaur raiders have ambushed a supply caravan crossing the canyon floor and slaughtered everyone aboard. This is more than a border skirmish.

Tauren leaders answer with organized counter-strikes against the tribes. They seek to stop the raids before Freewind Post is cut off from the rest of Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is written in the Urgent Message?
faq.answer: Urgent Message warns that centaur raids are rising sharply across Thousand Needles. Travelers and roads face immediate danger, and Freewind Post must prepare for war.

faq.q: Who wrote this message and who receives it?
faq.answer: Brave Moonhorn wrote Urgent Message near the Great Lift from the Barrens and addressed it to Cliffwatcher Longhorn, commander of Freewind Post.

faq.q: Why are the centaur attacking supply caravans?
faq.answer: The centaur tribes have long contested the arid lands of central Kalimdor with the tauren. They raid caravans on the canyon floor to seize provisions and deny the Horde safe passage through Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What warning does the scout give regarding the Grimtotem?
faq.answer: Brave Moonhorn warns the courier to avoid the nearby Grimtotem clan. Its warriors have grown aloof and suspicious toward other tauren.

angles.text: Urgent Message shows how fragile Horde supply lines are across southern Kalimdor. Isolated outposts rely on runners and braves to cross hostile land.
For tauren, the letter recalls their ancient blood feud with the centaur and growing unease about their Grimtotem kin.
